blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Conveners of the Movement Against Tyranny (MAT) on Monday condemned the police dispersal of protesters during the opening of the Asean Summit, calling for the release of those arrested and accountability for officers involved. In a statement dated Nov. 16, Sr. Mary John Mananzan, director Joel Lamangan and Dr. Carol Araullo said the police operation against demonstrators on Sunday brought back memories of repression under the martial law dictatorship of former President Ferdinand Marcos Sr. “The violent dispersal, brutal beatings, and mass arrests of protesters yesterday were chillingly reminiscent of the fascist tyranny we fought against during martial […]...
